name: patternwall
description: PatternWall - a generative iPhone wallpaper studio.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @patternwall/core && npm run dev --workspace @patternwall/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @patternwall/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @patternwall/core && npm run build --workspace @patternwall/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e --workspace @patternwall/web
